label: Cross-Agent Messaging
description: Reliable messaging between Animas using graph inbox nodes instead of ephemeral anima_message.

aspects.name: pattern
attributes: anima_message is sync and ephemeral — if target is busy/offline, message vanishes
Better: use a {name}-inbox node in each agent's graph as a persistent message queue
Send: graph_update target-inbox with new message attribute
Receive: check your own inbox node at conversation start, mark ack:true when read
